import unittest
from solution import SampleCatalog


class SampleCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def sample(self):
        return {"values": [1, 2.5], "points": [[1, 2], [3.5, -4]],
                "label": {"name": ["original"]}}

    def test_empty_and_length(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(SampleCatalog([])), 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(SampleCatalog([self.sample(), self.sample()])), 2)

    def test_construction_and_access_are_deeply_independent(self):
        source = self.sample()
        catalog = SampleCatalog([source])
        source["values"][0] = 999
        source["points"][0][0] = 999
        source["label"]["name"].append("changed")
        item = catalog[0]
        self.assertEqual(item, self.sample())
        item["values"].append(8)
        item["points"][0][0] = 8
        item["label"]["name"].append("item mutation")
        self.assertEqual(catalog[0], self.sample())

    def test_indices(self):
        first = self.sample()
        second = {"values": [9], "points": [], "label": "second"}
        catalog = SampleCatalog([first, second])
        self.assertEqual(catalog[-1], second)
        self.assertEqual(catalog[-2], first)
        for index in (True, False, 1.0, "0", None):
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    catalog[index]
        for index in (2, -3):
            with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
                catalog[index]

    def test_transform_called_once_on_copy_and_result_deep_copied(self):
        calls = []
        owned = {"values": [7], "points": [[8, 9]], "label": {"x": []}}
        def transform(sample):
            calls.append(sample)
            sample["values"][0] = 55
            return owned
        source = self.sample()
        catalog = SampleCatalog([source], transform)
        result = catalog[0]
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertIsNot(calls[0], source)
        self.assertEqual(result, owned)
        self.assertIsNot(result, owned)
        self.assertIsNot(result["values"], owned["values"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["points"], owned["points"])
        result["label"]["x"].append(1)
        owned["values"][0] = 100
        self.assertEqual(result["values"], [7])
        self.assertEqual(owned["label"], {"x": []})
        self.assertEqual(catalog[0]["values"], [100])
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)

    def test_invalid_transform_and_transform_result(self):
        for transform in (0, "callable", []):
            with self.subTest(transform=transform):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    SampleCatalog([], transform)
        bad_results = [None, [], {}, {"values": [], "points": [], "label": None, "extra": 1}]
        for bad in bad_results:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                catalog = SampleCatalog([self.sample()], lambda sample, bad=bad: bad)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    catalog[0]

    def test_malformed_samples(self):
        base = self.sample()
        malformed = [
            None, {},
            {"values": [1], "points": [], "label": "x", "extra": 1},
            {"values": [], "points": [], "label": "x"},
            {"values": "x", "points": [], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [True], "points": [], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [object()], "points": [], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": None, "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": [(1, 2)], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": [[1]], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": [[1, 2, 3]], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": [[False, 2]], "label": "x"},
            {"values": [1], "points": [[object(), 2]], "label": "x"},
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            SampleCatalog((base,))
        for sample in malformed:
            with self.subTest(sample=sample):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    SampleCatalog([sample])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
